mentions.h: 10 MILES' MURPHY SHIELD R.W. CHAMPIONSHIP (4th February).

mentions.note: joint holder of British Amateur track record at 20 miles, 2hrs. 49mins 26 secs.
set the previous Godstone record in 1910
won the first race in 1908 at Ruislip and five more times, last in 1920; third in 1922
walker, cited as a great walker

mentions.h: The Chart referred to by Mr. Belchamber.

mentions.note: past holder of the London to Brighton Walk record; guest of honour at the dinner
